{{Top|leg}}
The '''S.A.T Artisan Sect''' was a branch of peacekeepers that operated in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In space, the S.A.T Artisan Sect used [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk interceptors]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class starfighters]].<ref name="SWG:ES">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Endor system}}</ref>
